title: GrimChild Charm Heart
description: Transform your Minecraft health bar into a Hollow Knight charm HUD texture pack.
body:
GrimChild Charm Heart - Texture Pack

Transform your Minecraft health bar into a beautiful Hollow Knight charm with this minimalist texture pack!

 Features:
- Replaces all HUD hearts with Hollow Knight charm design
- Complete support for all heart types (Hardcore, Wither, Poisoned, Frozen, Absorbing, Vehicle, etc.)
- Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.11+
- Custom pack icon
- Pure visual changes, no gameplay modifications

 Compatibility:
- Minecraft 1.21.11+
- Works standalone or combined with other texture packs

 Credits:
- Pack created by dragonhaze8845
- Inspired by Hollow Knight theme

Enhance your Minecraft experience with this elegant and minimalist charm-themed HUD pack!
